from.place: Proof paragraph 2, middle derived mapping-complex comparison before the inverse limit: Infinity-categorical monadicity and the augmented counit bar resolution. Supporting foundation: Free coherent monad modules and their augmented free resolution.

title: Free coherent monad modules and their augmented free resolution
statement:
Use the coherent-diagram, mapping-space and quasicategory conventions of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the index categories and meaning of split augmented diagram of [lem-coef-infinity-split-augmentation-colimit]. Work in universes large enough for the following categories, with small mapping spaces in a possibly enlarged universe. Let $\mathcal C$ be an infinity-category. A coherent monad $T$ is a unital associative algebra in the monoidal infinity-category $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal C,\mathcal C)$ under composition: it has unit $\eta:1\to T$, multiplication $\mu:T^2\to T$, and all associativity and unit compatibilities. Its module infinity-category $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Alg}_T(\mathcal C)$ consists of objects $A\in\mathcal C$ with action $a:TA\to A$ and all coherent unit and associativity data, retaining coherent module maps and their higher simplices. Let $V:\mathcal A\to\mathcal C$ forget the action. Then $V$ reflects equivalences and has a left adjoint $F$, with $VF=T$, free module $F(c)=(Tc,\mu_c)$, and natural equivalences
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal A}(F(c),M)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal C}(c,VM).$$
This equivalence sends a module map $f$ to $V(f)\eta_c$ and its inverse sends $g$ to the module map with underlying map $a_M T(g)$. These are coherent equivalences of mapping-space bifunctors, and the free adjunction unit is $\eta$.

For each $M=(A,a)\in\mathcal A$ there is a natural augmented coherent simplicial diagram $R_\bullet M\to M$ with $R_rM=F(T^rA)$ for $r\geq0$. For $r\geq1$, its underlying faces are
$$d_i=T^i(\mu_{T^{r-i-1}A})\quad(0\leq i<r),\qquad d_r=T^r(a),$$
and its underlying degeneracies are $s_i=T^{i+1}(\eta_{T^{r-i}A})$ for $0\leq i\leq r$. Its degree-zero augmentation has underlying map $a:TA\to A$. The augmentation $R_\bullet M\to M$ is colimiting in $\mathcal A$. The underlying augmented diagram $VR_\bullet M\to A$ extends coherently to $N(\Delta_{-\infty})^{\mathrm{op}}$; its extra degeneracies are $h_{-1}=\eta_A$ and $h_r=\eta_{T^{r+1}A}$ for $r\geq0$. All structures and their higher compatibilities are natural in $M$. Neither the existence of all geometric realizations in $\mathcal C$ nor preservation of arbitrary realizations by $T$ is assumed.

source.place: Higher Algebra (2017), Corollaries 4.2.3.2 and 4.2.4.8, Construction 4.4.2.7, Example 4.7.2.7, Example 4.7.2.5 and Lemma 4.7.3.12; applied to the evaluation action of endofunctors on C. The free-module bar used in the proof of Lemma 4.7.3.13, printed pp. 688-689, is exactly this diagram. The colimit assertion is in the module category, and the splitting assertion is in C. Online source read; not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag states this infinity-categorical fact.
